Thanks for the quick updates. Consolidated rollup below (pulled from the tracker) — please sanity-check live in the sheet tomorrow before I send to Finance/CEO: 

- ACM-4732 (Acme Health): sales commit $420k ARR (verbal); legal redlines outstanding; procurement requested final pricing and region confirmation. Likely sign: 2025-09-30 -> status: at-risk -> action: Ben to provide final pricing sheet & confirm region by Mon 9/29 10:00 PT.
- ACME-ENT upsell: $75k, probable, sign date 2025-09-29; action: Marcus to confirm PO workflow and internal approver.
- ACME pilot: $50k, pipeline, awaiting security questionnaire; action: Rishi to follow up with Security to prioritize questionnaire response.

Top blockers overall: legal redlines turnaround time; PO before signature for >$250k slows close. If anyone expects a slide to the next quarter (realistically delayed >7 days), mark it as "slippage" in the tracker.

Next steps: update the tracker by EOD Monday (9/29). I'll produce a final commit rollup on Tue morning for Finance to include in monthly close. If any of you want me to join calls with procurement/legal, let me know and I'll be on standby.

Link to tracker: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACM4732
